summary:
直覺外科EPS大幅超預期11.57%，手術量與裝機動能維持強勁。
• EPS 2.53美元，大幅超越預期2.27美元，正向驚喜11.57%
• 營收28.7億美元，反映旺季較大規模
• 達文西手術量與裝機成長推升耗材收入
• 高黏著裝機基礎提供經常性收入能見度
ai_view:
訊號正向：11.57%的EPS大幅超標，反映達文西手術量持續成長與裝機基礎擴張，耗材經常性收入模式維持高品質獲利。短期動能佳，但極高本益比使股價對手術量增速與裝機指引高度敏感。中期關鍵在新平台採用與國際滲透。追蹤指標：達文西手術量年增、系統裝機數、耗材營收佔比、毛利率，以及新一代平台採用與全年手術量指引方向。

需留意：營收年增資料缺失，成長斜率須其他季度佐證；本益比50.63極高，容錯空間小；醫院資本支出與新競爭者風險

summary_en:
Intuitive Surgical beat EPS by a strong 11.57%, sustaining robust procedure and placement momentum.
• EPS of $2.53 strongly beat the $2.27 estimate, an 11.57% positive surprise
• Revenue of $2.87B reflects a larger peak-season base
• da Vinci procedure and placement growth lift consumable revenue
• A sticky installed base provides recurring-revenue visibility

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a strong 11.57% EPS beat reflects continued da Vinci procedure growth and installed-base expansion, with the recurring-consumable model sustaining high-quality earnings. Near-term momentum is healthy, but the very high P/E makes the stock highly sensitive to procedure-growth and placement guidance. Mid-term, new-platform adoption and international penetration are key. Track: da Vinci procedure growth, system placements, consumable revenue mix, gross margin, and next-gen platform adoption plus the direction of full-year procedure guidance.

Watch：Missing revenue YoY means the growth slope needs corroboration; P/E of 50.63 is very high with little margin for error; Hospital capex and new-competitor risk
